definitions.run_macro: Equal-weight mean of individual-run resolved-window agreement
definitions.pooled: Total correct resolved decisions divided by all resolved decisions
definitions.cell_macro: Equal-weight mean of 500 cells defined by dataset, stream seed, learner and scenario; delay seeds pooled within cells
definitions.delay_pooled: Mean delay over all resolved windows

note: Table 4 uses run-macro agreement and delay, but pooled FP/FN counts. Step25 main table uses decision-pooled aggregation. Different strategies can have different resolved-window sets.
